command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; test "$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p2-flowon-v2-20260912"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; FOUND=0; for i in 0 1 2 3 4; do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/p2-v2-nav.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/p2-v2-nav.xml "$OUT/nav-$i.xml" >/dev/null; if grep -q 'content-desc="Scan"' "$OUT/nav-$i.xml"; then FOUND=1; cp "$OUT/nav-$i.xml" "$OUT/radar.xml"; break; fi; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 4; sleep 1; done; test "$FOUND" -eq 1; echo P2_FLOWON_RADAR_NAV_PASS; if grep -q 'text="Paused"' "$OUT/radar.xml"; then python3 -c "import re,subprocess,pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('$OUT/radar.xml').read_text(); m=re.search(r'content-desc=\"Scan\"[^>]*bounds=\"\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\"',s); assert m,'Scan button not found'; x=(int(m.group(1))+int(m.group(3)))//2; y=(int(m.group(2))+int(m.group(4)))//2; subprocess.check_call(['adb','-s','$SERIAL','shell','input','tap',str(x),str(y)])"; echo P2_FLOWON_SCAN_STARTED; fi; sleep 20; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/p2-v2-live.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/p2-v2-live.xml "$OUT/live.xml" >/dev/null; SEEN=$(grep -o 'text="Seen ' "$OUT/live.xml" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo P2_FLOWON_LIVE_ROWS=$SEEN; test "$SEEN" -gt 0
